top_signals.title: The Biggest Jump in Global Crop Prices Since 2022 Threatens to Boost Inflation
top_signals.summary: Global agriculture prices notched their biggest quarterly jump since Russia’s invasion of Ukraine in early 2022 on fresh tensions in the Black Sea region and extreme weather, in a potential headwind for central bank inflation targets.
